title: Vintage The Crusaders Comics The Force Vol 15, 1983 - Crusade Comics
descriptionText:
This vintage comic book from 1983 features The Crusaders and their adventures in the religious genre. Published by Crusade Comics, this issue number 15 of The Force series title is a must-have for any US Comics collector. The character of Force is depicted in the story, making it a fan-favorite among fans of the series.

This collectible item falls under the category of Comic Books & Memorabilia and is a great addition to any collection. Whether you're a long-time fan or a new collector, this comic book is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own a piece of comic book history.
